name: samsungtv
title: Samsung TV
description: A remote for your Samsung TV under the keys, spoken to the TV on your network: the arrows and OK, your apps a digit away, the volume as a slider, the inputs as chips, typing into the TV's own keyboard from yours, turning it on and off, and the menu bar. With IP Remote on in the TV's settings it also knows the input on screen and jumps straight to one, moves the sound between the TV's speakers, Q-Symphony and a soundbar (and reconnects a soundbar gone quiet), sets the exact volume on the soundbar, changes the picture mode and the picture, and opens a web page on the TV. Pairs by pressing Allow on the TV. Its volume, power, inputs and sound output can drive another device's remote too (Settings › Groups).
author: pal

settings.label: TV
settings.description: Which paired TV the remote, the root commands and the bar item control, by its name. Empty: the one paired last. d on the remote switches, and writes it here.

settings.label: Dock
settings.description: The apps on the remote's dock, in order; each gets a digit, 1 to 8. Empty: the apps you open most. cmd+D in Samsung TV Apps adds or removes one.

settings.label: Input names
settings.description: A name for an input, one a line: the chips and the card say it instead of HDMI 1. Naming this input in the remote's cmd+K writes it here.

settings.label: Turn on
settings.text: Turn the TV on when the remote opens
settings.description: From standby, and from off with Power On with Mobile on in the TV's settings.

settings.label: Stay connected
settings.text: Keep the connection open in the background
settings.description: So the menu bar item follows what is on and a key answers at once. Off, pal connects while the remote is open and lets go a minute and a half after.

remote.title: Samsung TV Remote
remote.description: The arrows move, Enter is OK, Backspace goes back, h is Home; the app or input on screen with the sound output and the picture mode, your dock of apps on the digits, the volume as a slider, the inputs and the sound outputs as chips, the picture on v, a web page on w, and a field that types into the TV whenever it shows its keyboard.

keys.title: Next sound output (pairs sound and picture the first time)
Reconnect sound: to the TV's speakers and back
Picture: the mode, the values, the colour tone
Open a web page on the TV
Type into the TV (while it shows its keyboard)

picture.title: Samsung TV Picture
picture.description: The Samsung TV's picture: the mode as chips (Standard, Movie, Filmmaker, Dynamic, Eco), backlight, contrast, brightness, sharpness, colour and tint as sliders, and the colour tone. Needs sound and picture paired.

apps.title: Samsung TV Apps
apps.description: The apps on the Samsung TV; Enter opens one on the TV, the one on screen tagged.

keys.title: Add to or remove from the dock

commands.title: Samsung TV
commands.description: Turn on and off, home, play or pause, mute and the volume, the inputs, the TV's settings and its guide, as root results; with sound and picture paired also each sound output, Reconnect Sound, the picture modes, and the copied link opened on the TV.

setup.title: Set Up Samsung TV
setup.description: Finds the Samsung TVs on the network and pairs one: the TV asks whether to allow pal, you press Allow, then once more for sound and picture; ends with a check of what works.

tv.title: Samsung TV
tv.description: The app on the Samsung TV's screen, hidden while the TV shows another device's input and in standby. The popover is the remote: the arrows, the buttons, the volume, the inputs, the sound output and the dock on the digits.

keys.title: Type into the TV (while it shows its keyboard)

settings.label: Show
settings.description: Only while an app runs on the TV itself (on another device's input, like an Apple TV, that device's own item says what plays), or whenever the TV is on.

options.title: While an app is on screen

power.description: The Samsung TV's power: on, standby, off, unknown

app.description: The app on the Samsung TV's screen

input.description: The input on the Samsung TV's screen, by its name (HDMI 1, or the name given to it); needs sound and picture paired

sound.description: Where the Samsung TV's sound plays: TV Speaker, Q-Symphony, Soundbar; needs sound and picture paired

picture.description: The Samsung TV's picture mode: Standard, Movie, Filmmaker, Dynamic, Eco; needs sound and picture paired

name.description: up, down, left, right, select, back, home, menu, exit, play_pause, rewind, forward, volume_up, volume_down, mute, power, channel_up, channel_down, guide, info, or a raw KEY_ code

launch.description: Open an app on the TV

power.description: Turn the TV on or off

sound.description: Move the sound, or reconnect it (to the TV's speakers and back, for a soundbar gone quiet); needs sound and picture paired

to.description: reconnect, tv (its speakers), or an output by name (q-symphony, soundbar)

mode.description: standard, movie, filmmaker, dynamic or eco

store.tagline: Your Samsung TV's remote, apps, volume, inputs, sound and picture, from the keyboard
features: The arrows and OK, Back and Home under the keys; each part of the pad lights as you press
Your dock of apps on the digits, the one on screen marked; every app at the root: type `youtube`, press Enter
The volume as a slider and m to mute, set on the TV itself and, with IP Remote on, exactly on the soundbar too
The inputs as chips, the one on screen lit, a click jumps there; name them (HDMI 1 = Apple TV) and the card says so
The sound output as chips: the TV's speakers, Q-Symphony or a soundbar; shift+S reconnects a soundbar gone quiet, from the root or a link as well
The picture on v: the mode (Filmmaker, Movie, Standard…), backlight, contrast and the rest as sliders, the colour tone
w opens a web page on the TV, the link you copied already in the field
When the TV shows its keyboard, a field opens here: type with your keyboard, Enter sends it
Turns the TV off, and on from standby or off (Wake-on-LAN)
A menu bar item with the app on screen; its popover is the remote
With an Apple TV in the same group, the Apple TV's remote sets this TV's volume, inputs and sound output and turns both on
With Apple TV installed too, o opens the Apple TV's remote over this one and Escape comes back
Guided setup: finds the TV, you press Allow on it (once more for sound and picture), and it checks what works
